claim: Cached, uncached and faulted executions preserve the same parameterized save semantics; wrong context, collisions, read-only operation, write failure and uncertain commit do not cause duplicate or cross-context side effects.

target.name: tester-army/e2e semantic cache and real-browser asynchronous commit fixtures

task.path_reachability: C0 records a two-action async save and is gated before all treatments. Every treatment uses a copy of that seed. C1/C2 compare cached and uncached semantics. W1 opens /other under the same app identity. P1 makes unique(item) collide with literal alias. R1 uses defaulted cache mode with CI=1. F1 reaches a custom store write after the app workflow. U1 replays the seed through the real web engine, commits its tap, then throws ACTION_MAY_HAVE_COMMITTED.

arms.fault: cached replay with a new unique item value
--no-cache semantic reference with another unique value
same cache key but start route changes from / to /other
unique item value equals literal alias parameter
CI=1 with defaulted cache mode and a readable seed
custom cache store read miss then EACCES write throw
real browser tap returns then engine throws ACTION_MAY_HAVE_COMMITTED during replay
healthy cached negative control after the fault series

witness.delivery: Seed cache hashes and per-cell before/after manifests prove cache provenance. The store log proves F1 read/write calls and the thrown write. The engine fault log is written only after the real web tap returns. The local server ledger records input, save-request and save-committed independently of e2e reports.
witness.checker: grade.mjs applies the frozen task-contract checks to primary JSON, DOM snapshots, executor handoff logs, cache manifests and server event order. C0/C1/C2 normalized final DOM and event sequences are compared directly. Detection, reporting, containment, recovery and reverification will be narrated separately, not collapsed into pass/fail.
blind_spots: The executor is deterministic code, not an LLM; this audits the runner, cache and engine contract rather than model robustness.
One local asynchronous form and one Chromium version cannot cover all UI, network, mobile or distributed cache behavior.
The custom store proves one write-failure seam, not every filesystem permission failure.
The engine wrapper injects after the real tap returns while the app commit is asynchronous; other crash windows remain untested.
Experiments target pinned npm releases, not the upstream main branch.

grading.rubric: task-contract.txt is frozen before execution. Every valid cell must have one current-item request/commit and no cross-cell side effect. Cell-specific cache mode, handoff, executor-call, DOM, event-order and cache-byte checks are mechanical. Unexpected results are candidates for review, not automatically upstream bugs; invalid setup never becomes product evidence. C2 is the no-cache semantic reference; N1 is the post-series healthy control. U1 silence invalidates related negative conclusions.

invalid_rules: Chrome, CDP, local app, pinned dependency or fixture configuration fails before the target can execute the intended path.
C0 fails its healthy baseline gate; no treatment may then run.
A treatment seed is absent or differs from the frozen C0 seed before dispatch.
Report, server ledger, DOM, executor handoff or fault-delivery evidence required for that cell is missing.
U1 never reads the seed entry or injects during a live miss instead of cached replay.
Any attempt consumes budget; no retry or replacement execution is allowed under this card.

isolation.mode: Local static app and independent event server, temporary headless Chrome profile, fake HOME, per-cell copied caches, telemetry/update checks disabled, no real model or provider.
isolation.contamination: The C0 seed and fixture sources remain on disk, but each treatment can access only its own configured cache copy; the deterministic executor observes the browser and local witness endpoint and never reads pristine fixtures or seed files.

ethics.blast_radius: Nine local product executions and temporary files under this run directory; loopback HTTP only, no paid model calls, external telemetry, GitHub writes or third-party state changes.
